deploy-bot: Starting deploy v2.14.0 -> prod in change window (21:00-22:00 UTC). Canary: 5% traffic. release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.14.0 :rocket:

maria: quick check — is the backout runbook updated for the new migration and pin steps? I don't want surprises.

samir: updated at https://confluence/redwood/backouts/v2.14.0 — added DB rollback caveats, pin/unpin steps, and the "kill-switch" command.

chen: pin command is `deployctl pin --sha=sha1234 --reason="rollback v2.14"`

chen: immediate rollback (no DB revert) is `deployctl rollback --target=canary` — if we need full revert run the migration-reverse job:
```
./ops/migrations/reverse_migration.sh --env prod --id 20260315_add_kv_index
```

nora: DB revert is risky — we should only run migration-reverse if we hit schema conflict errors. For perf/latency issues, prefer pin and scale down new instances.

maria: agreed. Rollback criteria -> (1) errors >= 5% sustained for 10m, (2) p99 latency > 800ms for api-gateway for 5m, (3) partial auth failures. If any met, ops-oncall executes pin and we open incident channel.

ops-oncall: I'm on it. I'll be ready with the pin and the hotfix branch. Please tag me: @ops-oncall when you want me to execute.

samir: quick checklist I'm pasting here:
- confirm canary health metrics (errors, latency, traffic split)
- check db migration logs
- run smoke tests: `/smoke prod --suite=critical`
- have rollback sha and hotfix branch ready

samir: rollback commands:
```
# pin production to previous stable
deployctl pin --sha=stable-20260314 --reason="auto-backout v2.14"
# unpin after validation
deployctl unpin --sha=stable-20260314
```

maria: smoke tests were run in staging and passed. @deploy-bot start canary now when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — canary id=cb-879. Metrics group: https://metrics/redwood/cb-879 :eyes: 

chen: canary logs look clean so far. No 5xx spikes.

ops-oncall: I'm standing by in #incidents/ops with escalation tree and pager info.

maria: if we need to backout, call the "rollback" play from the runbook and @ops-oncall will pin. Also include the release notes link in the incident description.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% planned in 10m intervals. Next bump in 9m.

nora: leaving note — DB reverse migration steps require downtime for the table lock. Prefer pin+hotfix if we can avoid that.

maria: copy. Proceeding with canary gating. Will post update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
